title: Up to Six PhD Positions in Economics
institution: University of Gothenburg, Department of Economics
about: The University of Gothenburg's Department of Economics advertises up to six PhD positions in Economics (reference PAR 2026/802) for autumn 2027 admission, as fixed-term doctoral employment. Applications go through the university's recruitment system.
requirements: A master's degree in economics or a related field, such as finance or statistics

upskill.name: Statistical & Mathematical Foundations I
why: "master's degree in economics or a related field, such as finance or statistics" → objective "Apply inferential statistical methods, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, and analysis of variance (ANOVA), to draw conclusions from samples"

card_alt: EduCut Connect card for "Up to Six PhD Positions in Economics" at University of Gothenburg, Department of Economics, Gothenburg, Sweden, deadline 1 Feb 2027. Photo: Gamla stan and Riddarholmen, Stockholm.
